name: starter_patch
note: The app's starter patch, first 400 ms (golden size). Host sine 110 Hz at 1.25 V stands in for the test osc at -12 dB on PLEAT IN 1. Slope 1 cycles 1.5 s up and 2.5 s down into PLEAT VC (the normal, depth 0.5, Fold 2). PLEAT OUT cables into RECTIFIER IN, RECTIFIER OUT 1 into VCA IN, and Slope 2 cycling (20 ms up, 350 ms down) into VCA VC, so the VCA pulses. VCA OUT is the app's host output.
